description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Revenue Protection Order No. 06/2023 - Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves regulatory matters under the Revenue Protection Act, specifically issuing an order related to customs import duties and tariff rates under the Sri Lanka-Singapore Free Trade Agreement. It contains legal/regulatory provisions amending customs ordinances and rescinding previous orders, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation." While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not focus on his appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the regulatory order he is issuing under statutory authority.
